Name: Ralsei Horse Override
Author: larkylovesyou2
Description:
Back when Deltarune Chapters 3 and 4 first released, I thought to myself: "surely SOMEONE is bound to make a Ralsei horse override! We got [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3887]Pam Horse[/url], so surely THIS isn't too big an ask! Give it a few months."

So I waited. And waited. And nobody made it! So now that I'm getting into modding myself, I've taken matters into my OWN hands. You did this to yourselves, Stardew Valley Modding Community. You forced my hand.

:: NOTES ::

- This mod comes bundled with both a Content Patcher version and an Alternative Textures version. The AT version won't do anything if Alternative Textures isn't installed.
- With Alternative Textures, you can use the Scissors to change the Horse's texture by left-clicking to open the menu. Search for "Ralsei" if you have a lot of textures and don't want to scroll through them.
- The Content Patcher version directly overrides the base game horse, but you can safely remove it ("[CP] Ralsei Horse Override" in the mods list) if you don't want it to do that.

Downloads.Description: Note: This mod will likely conflict with any other horse sprite overrides. Please install only one at a time.
